_about: Component registry for the LumeBook project. tools/lumebook.py reads it to find what changed, what that change affects (feeds), what it can rebuild by itself (build.auto) and what needs a person or Claude (publish). Paths are relative to this folder. Add a component here whenever a new workstream starts.

facts.name: Shared facts (links, offer, dates, creator lists)
facts.notes: Read by the dashboard and by the creator map build (offer percentage, split example, paid-hold list). check compares the offer wording and brand spelling against the sites and form.

brand.name: Brand assets (logos, mascot, fonts, backgrounds)
brand.notes: Canonical copies live here. Sites and the pipeline need their own physical copy (deploy folders, served fonts); `lumebook.py sync` refreshes them, check reports drift.

design.name: LumeBook design system (tokens + lb- components)
design.notes: Every internal page inlines lumebook.css at build (design.py: head() also inlines the category classes from categories.json). The SMM plan and the dashboard have no page build, so they link synced copies of lumebook.css and of categories.css (sync writes categories.css from categories.json, then copies it). categories.json says which category of which page gets which of the eight category hues (18 Oct 2026); the dashboard's refresh.py reads its workstreams. Heebo main font, Assistant secondary (18 Oct 2026). Not used by the ambassadors site. The project nav (5 Nov 2026): hq-tools.json is HQ's built-in tool list, nav.src.js draws the top bar (HQ's topics), the location path, the collapsible side bar (every tool) and the bottom nav bar on phones; design.head() inlines both as nav.js (head(nav=False) only for the public creator brief), sync writes shared/design/nav.js and copies it to HQ and the SMM plan.

media.name: Creative media (one folder per job: reels, podcasts, character packs, stories, trend recreations)
media.notes: Since 14 Oct 2026 every image, video and audio file LumeBook makes or collects lives in media/projects/YYYY-MM-DD-slug/ (output/ and video/ were folded in; media/inbox/ holds unsorted files). The index and the cloud-archive steps are in media/README.md. Media files are not in git. Exceptions: shared/brand (canonical brand files), the carousel pipeline's drafts and approved runs, research downloads.

product-docs.name: Product brief, Q4 strategy, carousel playbook (Hebrew), UGC research
product-docs.notes: The nightly carousel skill reads the brief and playbook sections 4.2, 5, 7, 8 every night.

brand-marketing-system.name: Brand and marketing system (internal working draft)
brand-marketing-system.notes: Draft ICP, personas, emotional territory, positioning, proof, messaging, conversion and research plan. Hypotheses are not approved public claims. Hebrew voice rules remain in .claude/skills/lumebook-hebrew-voice. No automatic publishing or pipeline propagation.

smm-plan.name: SMM plan site

publish.note: ships inside the dashboard site at /plan/ (its own Vercel project was retired 8 Oct 2026)

rules: Every Hebrew change in index.html is mirrored in content.en.md in the same commit (root .githooks/pre-commit).
Links lumebook.css, a synced copy of shared/design/lumebook.css (no build step; edited in the site editor).

signup-form.name: Creator signup Google Form (Apps Script source)

publish.note: re-run the script in Apps Script or edit the Form

ambassadors.name: Ambassadors landing page + creators hub (retired)
ambassadors.notes: Retired on 11 Oct 2026: Yarin no longer uses the Vercel ambassadors site. The folder is kept as an archive and is not deployed, synced or maintained. The old pages may still be online at https://lumebook-ambassadors.vercel.app until the Vercel project is removed.

creator-map.name: Creator map (outreach CRM, up to 100 new creators every Saturday)
rules: Never edit the built HTML; edit src/template.html and data.
creator-map.notes: Grows every Saturday at 21:00: scheduled task lumebook-creator-map-weekly (Claude desktop app, built-in browser signed in to Instagram, read only) runs the method in src/research/weekly/README.md and appends through src/research/merge_pass.py. The Sunday 10:00 task lumebook-creator-refresh then re-reads every creator, the new ones included. Every day at 09:00 the task lumebook-creator-posts-daily reads the creator posts linked in the books tab (src/posts/README.md) into state/posts.json, which the page fetches; no rebuild needed.

creator-content-conversion.name: Creator content and purchase intent (round 1: 41 creators; round 2: 134 creators, 1,456 posts, 22,428 comments)
creator-content-conversion.notes: report.html is built from report.md content, evidence.md, methodology.md and the CSVs by src/build_page.py (local only, not published: it holds sales figures). Informs creator choice (creator-map) and the four-week tests in the SMM plan. Internal: holds sales figures from docs/lumebook-sales-data-decisions-2026-10-12.md, keep it off public pages. Raw media and raw comments (with usernames) stay out of the repo; src/ has the collection and analysis scripts.

israeli-product-reels.name: Israeli creator product Reels: filming research and playbook (197 watched, 173 verified, 108 creators, 8 deep dives, 8-question table, 63 research principles)
israeli-product-reels.notes: 15 Oct 2026. How to film LumeBook product Reels with a phone, from 173 verified Israeli creator Reels (41 in the morning round, 132 added the evening of 15 Oct): seven approaches, five concepts with linted Hebrew scripts (fallback voice, comment word לומי) and a 60-90 minute first shoot. source-index.md and sources.csv are built by src/build_index.py from src/review.json, src/coded/ and the 15 Oct Instagram counts. Product facts in the scripts were read on lumebook.com on 15 Oct (src/product-facts-2026-10-15.md); re-check price and delivery before posting. Cites internal figures from docs/lumebook-sales-data-decisions-2026-10-12.md, so keep it off public pages. Media (other creators' videos, frames, transcripts) in media/projects/2026-10-15-israeli-product-reels/, not in git and not for re-hosting. 18 Oct 2026: SMM research (four passes, 63 principles with sources and strength, smm-research/notes/ and principles.md built by src/build_principles.py), the 8-question table (src/table/CODE.json per Reel, coded from src/TABLE_BRIEF.md, each why citing principle IDs) and the sample check (src/evidence_check.py: plays per follower and interaction rate with and without each feature, smm-research/sample-check.md). Followers for all 108 creators in src/followers.json (og18 = 18 Oct).

lotem-lerner-carousels.name: @lotem_lerner carousel teardown (all 52 carousels, 592 slides)
lotem-lerner-carousels.notes: 29 Oct 2026. How a sleep consultant (18.4K) builds carousels: visual, topics, hooks, the three-part point slide, mid-post comment keywords, and what performs. Coded by Sonnet agents from src/AGENT_BRIEF.md, spot-checked by hand. Slides in media/projects/2026-10-29-lotem-lerner-carousels/ (not in git, never re-post).

creator-brief.name: Creator Reel brief page (Hebrew, for barter creators)
creator-brief.notes: 15 Oct 2026. Source: the Hebrew part of creator-brief.md (the English notes on top are for Yarin and stay off the page). Lint first: python3 research/israeli-product-reels/src/lint_creator_brief.py (brief + the page's own UI Hebrew, voice_lint with CTA and code word לומי). Facts checked on lumebook.com on 15 Oct; re-check price and delivery before sending. The artifact is private until Yarin shares it.

reels-research-page.name: Product Reels Playbook page (the full Israeli product Reels research, for Yarin)
reels-research-page.notes: 15 Oct 2026. One page with every section of the research: overview, findings, seven approaches, fixes, five concepts with Hebrew scripts, first shoot, phone set-up, logging, eight deep dives with the annotated frame strips embedded (from media/projects/2026-10-15-israeli-product-reels/annotated/, about 3.9 MB), sources and limits. Built from the markdown; never edit the HTML. Private artifact; it quotes internal figures from the 12 Oct sales note, so do not share it outside LumeBook. 18 Oct 2026: three more views, the reel-by-reel 8-question table (filters, one-question mode, cards on phones), the SMM research principles and the sample check, rendered by src/reel_table.py. 18 Oct 2026 (later): rebuilt as an app for Yarin ('organize this tool like a pro'): Apple-style sidebar with the 8 tools as coloured tiles, one page per tool and per principle (rule, how to apply, our Reels' numbers, examples, sources behind toggles), Reel library with a compare-one-question mode and a page per Reel, proof board, pre-post checklist (ticks in the viewer's browser), concepts, shoot, patterns, deep dives, notes, method. Heebo main, Assistant secondary. src/build_research_page.py builds the data; src/page/playbook.css and playbook.js render it; plain hash routes (#tool-hook, #p-H1, #reel-CODE).

kids-lab.name: Kids content lab (64 shorts)
kids-lab.notes: videos/ (706 MB) and analysis frames are raw research media; re-downloadable with the dl_*.sh scripts.

carousel-research.name: Carousel research v2 (752 accounts)
carousel-research.notes: The pipeline's list of code words taken by competitors (carousel_lib.py) comes from this page; update it by hand.

carousel-playbook.name: Carousel playbook page

build.note: Uses the project venv (.venv, gitignored) for the markdown package: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install markdown

carousel-playbook.notes: Hook families in carousel/carousel-pipeline/hook-bank.md follow playbook section 7; update the bank by hand.

carousel-audit.name: Carousel audit (every published carousel: inventory, Instagram numbers, creative scores, tagged links)
carousel-audit.notes: Local only, not published: holds Instagram numbers and sales figures. New Meta export: python3 research/carousel-audit/src/audit.py import <file.csv>; it lists carousels that need an inventory entry and a score. Tagged links before posting: audit.py link <topic_id>. audit.py hook-results --write copies 7+ day old results into carousel/carousel-pipeline/hook-results.json, which can move hook formulas in the hook bank, so it runs only when asked. Reads slide PNGs from carousel/carousel-pipeline/approved/*-all/ and hook fields from each run's approved.json. Started 24 Oct 2026 (README.md there).

fal-trial.name: fal.ai carousel trial (frozen reference)
fal-trial.notes: Source of the slide layout the pipeline copies (source/flare_carousel.py). Not rebuilt. Moved into media/projects on 14 Oct 2026 (it was under carousel/).

carousel-pipeline.name: Carousel Machine (nightly carousel pipeline)
carousel-pipeline.schedule: cloud routine 'Hook Studio weekly batch (cloud)' (its name from before the rename): Thursday 19:00 UTC (22:00 Israel summer time, 21:00 winter), 7 packs + 14 games and books carousels to batch/ID; review_server.py pulls them (since 16 Oct 2026; the nightly runs before that)
carousel-pipeline.notes: Hooks first, then content, then slide design (10 Oct 2026). Self-contained: scripts find their own folder. Skills: .claude/skills/lumebook-carousel, .claude/skills/lumebook-hebrew-voice.
carousel-pipeline.on_upstream_change: check whether hook-bank.md (playbook section 7), the competitor code words in scripts/carousel_lib.py (carousel research) or topic-bank.md need updating

dashboard.name: Project dashboard

build.note: The 08:14 scheduled task runs refresh.py (Instagram + signup Sheet), pushes the artifact database, builds and deploys.

publish.capabilities: db, user, mcp (Google Drive read_file_content), assets, downloads and sample (the course's Claude check) on contract 0.2.96, as stored on version 5 (31 Oct 2026); omit capabilities and contract on later publishes (sites/dashboard/course/README.md, Publishing). The course view writes course/tasks, course/progress, course/numbers, course/settings and course/links

deploy.note: the nightly commit job (tools/nightly_commit.py) builds and deploys it when a watched file changed; includes the plan at /plan/ and, since 05 Nov 2026, read-only copies of five research pages at /research/<slug>/ (the facts.json artifacts with a web address: competitor teardown, kids content lab, carousel research, carousel playbook, parent communities). Pages with internal sales figures or personal data never get a web address.

dashboard.notes: Default view since 31 Oct 2026: tasks and lessons (sites/dashboard/course/, README there; content from course/, plan in course/curriculum.md). It replaced the canvas work board (19 to 31 Oct 2026, now in _to-delete/sites/dashboard/board/). Course state saves to the artifact database under course/* (never snapshot, history, tracker or the old boards/), and on Vercel or the local server only in that browser.

course.name: LumeBook pipeline course (lessons, task types, checklists, projects)

build.note: Fails on a lesson file that breaks the fixed English format, an em or en dash, Hebrew outside `code` (none at all in lessons.json), or curriculum.md section 5 drifting from lessons.json.

course.notes: Started 31 Oct 2026 for Yarin, due 30 Nov 2026. course/discovery.md (approved), course/curriculum.md (approved), course/lessons.json (single source of truth), course/lessons/Lnn.md (lesson texts, English since 31 Oct 2026 on Yarin's ask; the Hebrew first version is in _to-delete/course/lessons-he/). Each question 3 model answer is the rubric Claude grades against in the page, and each project's check in lessons.json is what Claude looks for in a hand-in. No LumeBook sales figures in lesson files: they ship to the public Vercel copy.

parent-communities.name: Parent community map (361 FB/WA communities, closest to Ashkelon first)
parent-communities.notes: Shooting day for social media, for a free book (shared/facts.json parent_shoot_offer), re-ranked 2026-10-14 by distance from Ashkelon. build_page.py also writes research/parent-community-outreach.md. 21 WhatsApp invites unverified (WhatsApp 429).

hook-studio-page.name: Carousel Machine page (its front page)
hook-studio-page.notes: Built from the newest pack that has a games and books carousel (drafts/DATE/reco-carousel.json; older nights games-carousel.json and books-carousel.json). Shows the night's pack, validation state, contact sheets, the two modes, the rules and the commands. Rebuild after each nightly run, then republish.

sales-readout.name: Sales readout (12 Oct admin data in plain words, social decisions, the numbers)
sales-readout.notes: Local only, not published: holds internal sales figures. The Markdown is the source; ripple rebuilds the HTML. The seven social decisions also live in the SMM plan (section id decisions) without figures.

reel-calendar.name: November reel calendar (one reel a day, 05 to 30 Nov 2026: scripts, filming days, captions)
reel-calendar.notes: 04 Nov 2026 (Yarin: a reel content system to the end of November, one a day like reel 1.1). reels.json is the only source; reels.py build writes the page and both md files, reels.py lint runs the Hebrew voice lint, new <id> opens a media project, done <id> marks a reel posted. Series colours: categories.json set reel-series. Superseded 05 Nov 2026 by the reels-hub component: the stand-alone calendar artifact is no longer linked or republished; this component still builds the two md files and the page that the hub reuses.

reels-hub.name: מערכת הרילס: the one Hebrew tool for everything about reels (November calendar with editing, playbook, 63 principles, research library, tools, reels made)
reels-hub.notes: 05 Nov 2026 (Yarin: integrate the reel calendar so there is only one tool, everything in Hebrew). Built by src/build_reels_explorer.py: the calendar view is the stand-alone calendar page cut into parts by src/hub_calendar.py (month grid, editable reel popup, made ticks, comment box), the research text is the Hebrew translation in src/he/*.json of playbook.md and principles.md (rerun the translation when those change; a missing key falls back to English). Edits, ticks and comment requests save to this artifact's own database (collections edits, made, requests); reels.py merge reads an export of edits from here. Replaces the stand-alone calendar artifact DGXzTyAGSYLXmAeYjRPt1E.

partners-page.name: Partners page for children's book authors and early-childhood professionals (route /IL/he/partners on the store, he en ar ru; local review prototype, implementation brief and internal commercial review)

publish.note: Not published and not deployed, on purpose. lumebook.com (a React app) is not in this repo, so the page goes live only when the store team integrates it from docs/partners/implementation-brief.md. No .vercel link in the folder.

rules: Local review only: never deploy from sites/lumebook-partners.

Copy lives in sites/lumebook-partners/src/content/<lang>.json; never edit the built index.html files by hand. After any copy change run python3 sites/lumebook-partners/src/build.py then python3 sites/lumebook-partners/lint_copy.py.
No commercial terms on the page until Yarin approves a standard offer; docs/partners/internal-review-note.md lists what is still open and holds the proposed terms (internal, no names).
partners-page.notes: Created 06 Nov 2026 from Yarin's brief. Visual language copied from the store's ambassador page (lumebook.com/IL/he/ambassadors, read 06 Nov 2026). The inquiry form does not call the ambassador sign-up API (it would create a link and an account): with form[data-endpoint] empty it shows a hand-off to WhatsApp or email and never a success state. 06 Nov 2026 later: Yarin confirmed a standard partner offer exists (terms not given yet), the inquiry address yarin@lumebook.com, monthly sales reporting, a dedicated author page and a printed copy as standard, and wants en, ar and ru versions; shared/facts.json has a partners block. Arabic and Russian were drafted by Claude and need a native reader before going live.

site-editor.name: Edit button on every page (in-page editor + edits layer)
site-editor.notes: Since 05 Nov 2026 every HTML page the project server shows (localhost:8780, Carousel Machine through /hook-studio/ too) gets a pencil button at the bottom left: Yarin edits text, colors, pictures, size and spacing and drags things around right in the page. Hand-written pages listed in pages.json (the SMM plan) are edited in their own file; every other page keeps its edits in shared/site-editor/edits/<page>.json, applied by overlay.js whenever the page shows and written into the page's file as the lumebook-edits block (build() after each build, ripple and the nightly job for pages rebuilt elsewhere), so edits survive rebuilds and reach the artifact and Vercel copies on the next republish or deploy. python3 tools/lumebook.py edits lists edited pages. After editing tools/site_editor.py or tools/lumebook.py: python3 tools/serve_login.py restart. README.md there.
